description: SELECTED RUN · Saved status, domain verdicts and identity assess only the selected Run ID. Missing saved evidence remains UNKNOWN; global alerts never overwrite the saved run verdict. Canonical presentation contract: dashboard-2.0; UID v1/v2 suffixes are stable compatibility identifiers. Shared selectors are Workflow, Pipeline, Run Type and Run ID; local lookup, derived selectors and diagnostic views have role-specific scope. Saved outcomes, current alert urgency, coverage and replay readiness are distinct state vocabularies. Saved refresh is 1m (60 seconds), matching the refresh selector. CURRENT managed panels use their own clock.

Independent CURRENT clocks and the live-clock instructions below apply only in the managed adaptive profile. GLOBAL / CURRENT · Counts of BioETL FIRING and PENDING alerts, independent of Selected Run and all selectors. FIRING has satisfied the rule's for duration; PENDING has not. A saved SUCCESS/OK never clears these counts. A valid zero means no active alerts, not verified pipeline health. Missing Prometheus scrape or request failure is UNKNOWN/source unavailable. panels.title: Review Processing Anchor Age · 24h / 72h · period end
panels.description: TIME RANGE SNAPSHOT · Evaluated at the selected period end, including absolute historical periods; not live data. Independent CURRENT clocks and the live-clock instructions below apply only in the managed adaptive profile. CURRENT · Visible Pipeline filter; independent of Run ID, Workflow, Run Type and the historical range. Age of the oldest observed successful-run START processing anchor, from bioetl_data_freshness_seconds (emitted by successful DQ evaluation). This is not completion time or the provider's input-record event time; source-record freshness is unverified. Per-entity duplicate sources use max timestamp, matching the alert rules. STALE >24h is warning and >72h is critical, matching BioETLDataFreshnessLagHigh/Critical; both alerts additionally require 15m pending. Within 24h applies only to observed entities and does not prove complete coverage, a live provider probe or saved-run health. Entities with missing/invalid/future timestamps are unverified; no valid entities remains UNKNOWN. Inspect Telemetry Coverage for missing entities; query time is not primary event time.

panels.title: Review Selected Run Status
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Overall verdict is the data quality assessment of this Run ID. Processing is the ETL outcome. Trust is the saved Trust verdict and does not authorize replay. Saved evidence for this Run ID. Missing checks are INCOMPLETE; missing selection is SELECT RUN; request failure is Source unavailable. N/A means explicitly inapplicable. VALID EMPTY is an empty successful query. This saved verdict does not authorize replay. Reason explains the saved assessment; missing archive evidence remains INCOMPLETE. Evidence completeness remains available in the saved report. Reason is a shortened preview; Inspect Data retains complete Reason details. If this panel has no result, inspect Review Run Domains (panel 9002) and its query status. No result alone cannot distinguish a successful query without evidence from a source query error.

panels.title: Review Run Context
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · AUTO shows the latest run by start time in the current scope, including unfinished runs. EXPLICIT keeps the requested Run ID and shows evidence for that run only. An explicit Run ID takes precedence over Pipeline; an overridden Pipeline filter is identified in Context. Context checked at is this Grafana query evaluation time, not run start, browser click, server cache load or catalog freshness. Refresh re-evaluates the displayed context. UNKNOWN is missing evidence; request failure is Source unavailable. This context assesses that run only, not a fleet verdict. TIME RANGE telemetry never proves this run. Empty is a coverage gap, not a pass. Backend failure indicates an unavailable source and must not be interpreted as an empty successful response. Saved assessment at is the persisted assessment clock, and Saved age is elapsed time since that clock. No cadence or freshness threshold for the run's source data is provided by this endpoint: source freshness remains Not verified. The reader cache policy does not establish source freshness and is available only in raw context inspection. If this panel has no result, inspect Review Run Domains (panel 9002) and its query status. No result alone cannot distinguish a successful query without evidence from a source query error. AUTO is local to Run Overview and Data Quality; Replay Readiness and Incident Workspace request an explicit exact run.

panels.title: Review Run Identity
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Pipeline and full Run ID identify the saved run. Run Type and Started at (with saved UTC offset) characterize its execution. SELECT RUN means no selected run context. Missing saved values are Not recorded; request failures remain QUERY ERROR. VALID EMPTY means an empty successful response; it does not replace UNKNOWN for missing required evidence. Backend failure indicates an unavailable source and must not be interpreted as an empty successful response. Empty is a coverage gap: required saved evidence is missing, not a pass. Request failure is Source unavailable. If this panel has no result, inspect Review Run Domains (panel 9002) and its query status. No result alone cannot distinguish a successful query without evidence from a source query error.

panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Saved provider evidence for this Run ID. Cached Bronze means the provider API was not called: Check performed is No and Check result is —. Provider check identifies saved preflight evidence, not the extraction transport. UNKNOWN means the performed state or result is unknown. Since completed is elapsed wall time from the saved completion timestamp, updated on refresh. Expand Provider HTTP details for recorded response time, HTTP status and endpoint; missing details are not invented. VALID EMPTY is an empty successful response. SELECT RUN requires context; QUERY ERROR is a failed request. VALID EMPTY means an empty successful response; it does not replace UNKNOWN for missing required evidence. Backend failure indicates an unavailable source and must not be interpreted as an empty successful response.

panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Saved provider check result via check_result_display. Cached Bronze (provider API not called) shows NOT PROBED. Missing evidence stays UNKNOWN. OK/WARN/CRIT color the saved check verdict, not live fleet health. SELECT RUN means no Run ID is selected. VALID EMPTY means no saved provider check. Source unavailable means backend unavailable or request failure. VALID EMPTY means an empty successful response; it does not replace UNKNOWN for missing required evidence. Backend failure indicates an unavailable source and must not be interpreted as an empty successful response. The visible note distinguishes a deliberately skipped provider probe from absent evidence; only the recorded provider observation is labelled Probe time. Run completion is not probe time.

An unknown count is empty, not 0. UNFINISHED means no terminal event. Prometheus does not change this table. Request failure is Source unavailable. Removal counters are per-stage saved funnel removals; untracked stages stay UNKNOWN. Excluded % is excluded_by_contract / stage records in; Saved % is records out / stage records in. Empty or incomplete inputs are UNKNOWN. VALID EMPTY means an empty successful response; it does not replace UNKNOWN for missing required evidence. Backend failure indicates an unavailable source and must not be interpreted as an empty successful response. Empty is a coverage gap: required saved evidence is missing, not a pass. Request failure is Source unavailable.

panels.title: Review Contract Exclusions
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Excluded-by-contract records summed across Bronze, Silver and Gold. Exclusion rate uses Bronze records out: below soft limit OK, at soft limit WARN, at hard limit CRIT. Limits come from pipeline configuration at dashboard generation, not historical run overrides. UNKNOWN means incomplete tracking or invalid counters; SELECT RUN requires a Run ID. Failed requests remain QUERY ERROR. Quarantined, filtered and deduplicated records are separate outcomes and are not included. VALID EMPTY means an empty successful response; it does not replace UNKNOWN for missing required evidence. Backend failure indicates an unavailable source and must not be interpreted as an empty successful response. Empty is a coverage gap: required saved evidence is missing, not a pass. Request failure is Source unavailable. Empty evidence shows NO DATA (excluded UNKNOWN), N/A when no Run ID is selected, or NO RECORDS when the catalog has no runs.

panels.title: Review FK Comparison Scope
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Persisted FK comparison in the exact parent workflow. selected-snapshot means absence only inside the pinned reference, not absence from the complete provider. Expiry can affect all selected rows while execution succeeds; remaining rows and scope stay explicit. Missing evidence is UNKNOWN and failed requests remain QUERY ERROR. Saved Evidence and Replay Readiness retain their independent checks. VALID EMPTY means an empty successful response; it does not replace UNKNOWN for missing required evidence. Backend failure indicates an unavailable source and must not be interpreted as an empty successful response. An empty comparison is not a blank table: N/A means no Run ID is selected, NO RECORDS means no runs are in scope, NO DATA means FK comparison rows were not returned.
